findings.why: Viteria Lanzo is not in the supplier master, the qualification list or the capabilities list. Its standing and audit status cannot be checked. Purchasing/SQE must supply the supplier record.

sources.quote: 4.4 A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: There is no 3.1 certificate for MAT-C67S from Viteria Lanzo. The SQE (E. Gallo) must obtain one.

sources.quote: 4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The ASL covers CL-115 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR, but only for SUP-G. Viteria Lanzo has no approval for it.

sources.quote: 4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The ASL covers CL-115 at PLT-PIN for CUST-NOR, but only for SUP-G. Viteria Lanzo has no approval for it.

sources.quote: 7.1 The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts

findings.why: CL-115 is used on PRG-X (Aurelia). A change of source needs written Aurelia approval under revision 4, which replaces revision 3. R4 7.2 also requires notification at least 90 days before implementation.

sources.quote:
5.1 A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before
the first shipment.

findings.why: CL-115 is also used on PRG-Y (Nordhavn). A change of source needs Nordhavn approval before the first shipment.
